title: Minimum processor state
shortDescription: Minimum processor state: tunes processor power management behavior for performance vs efficiency tradeoffs.
longDescription: Controls processor power management behavior through powercfg policy indexes. Suitable for normal tuning profiles once verified on target hardware.
notes: exposed
name: Minimum processor state
description: Controls processor power management behavior through powercfg policy indexes. Suitable for normal tuning profiles once verified on target hardware.
whatItDoes: Adjusts the active power plan value for minimum processor state using apply/verify/rollback flow.
whyGamersCare: Can affect frametime stability, ramp latency, and consistency during burst workloads.
fpsImpact: Can improve FPS consistency; rarely increases average FPS alone.
powerImpact: Typically neutral or power-saving depending on value.
heatImpact: Can raise sustained temperatures under load.
stabilityRisk: Low to Medium depending on aggressiveness of chosen value.
avoidIf: Avoid aggressive values on thermally constrained laptops.
sourceEvidence: Documented setting with writable mapping.
